notes:
Summary: WillowGate runs a B2B SaaS customer success platform with a large multi-tenant knowledge base (KB) used to power in-app support and automated assistant. They want a hosted inference path to reduce ops burden and unit cost vs current mix of OpenAI + Pinecone.

Stakeholders: CTO (Marcus Lee) - performance lead, Head of Product (Priya Anand) - UX/latency sensitive, Infra lead (Samir Khan) - security & residency. Quote from CTO: "We need p95 search+rerank under 120ms at peak — anything above that breaks the desktop UX."

Technical constraints: currently ~1.2M FAQ+transcript passages indexed (moderate scale). Expect incremental growth to ~2M in 12 months. Typical query pattern: spikes tied to product launches — baseline 200 qps, peak 700-900 qps sustained for 10-30 minute windows. Primary pipeline: embed query -> ANN vector search -> top-100 candidate retrieval -> fast reranker (cross-encoder) to produce final answers.

Why Redwood: looking for single runtime that can serve both embeddings and low-latency reranks cheaply. Interested in Redwood's automatic KV/prefix caching and batching controls. Also wants re-ranking fallbacks: if high load, degrade to cheap bi-encoder scoring instead of cross-encoder.

Procurement notes: procurement expects vendor SOC2 and SSO/SAML in place. EU data residency required for subset of enterprise customers (contractual). Legal has a 1-week security questionnaire pending. Budget committee expects vendor TCO showing <$0.01 avg cost/query for production rerank pipeline (embeddings + rerank amortized).

Sales/Eng activities so far: demo of hosted API (2/20), deep technical call on reranking architecture (3/1), internal cost model request submitted (3/4). Agreed POC plan: Redwood to run a scaled renderer sim with 10M queries/day for 48 hours and provide perf/cost breakdown.
